name: projects
description: The life of a project, kept in its README: /projects:new interviews for the finish line, the people, how it is versioned and whether it is sensitive; /projects:adopt adds what an existing project is missing and changes how it is versioned; hold, board, pickup and close pause, show, resume and archive the work. A session-start line says where the folder's project stands, and which of its resources this machine has not mapped.
